summary: Deepgram Pay As You Go grants $200 in signup credits with no credit card and no expiration. The earlier Flux TTS free promo (through September 14, 2026) has ended: Flux TTS is now billed at $0.0450/1k characters pay-as-you-go. A separate 'Buy Flux TTS, get matching credits' promotion adds $1 in credits per $1 spent, up to $500, for Pay As You Go and Growth plans, ending December 31, 2026. That spend-to-match deadline does not apply to the ongoing $200 signup credit.
claim_steps: Click Sign Up Free at deepgram.com/pricing (no credit card required).
Create a console account and an API key.
Use the $200 credit on STT, TTS, and Voice Agent APIs (credits do not expire).

If considering the separate paid Flux TTS credit-match promotion, review its terms: Pay As You Go and Growth plans are eligible, matching is $1 per $1 spent up to $500, and the promotion ends December 31, 2026. This is not a deadline for the $200 signup offer.
